name: app-circle-diagram-problem-and-solution-cards-slide
title: Problem and Solution Cards on a Big Circle
whatItIs: A white slide with a mixed sans and italic serif headline, a ruler-tick line with dotted connectors down to two Problem cards and one central Solution card set inside a huge hairline circle, ending with a CEO quote.
whatItMeans: Connectors and the circle show problems funnelling into one answer, and hairline detail keeps it elegant.
techniques: Dotted connectors from a ruler line to cards
Problem cards flanking a central Solution card
Huge hairline circle as a container
Red and green square markers for problem and solution
Quote with avatar at the bottom

vocabulary.definition: A line of tick marks used as a decorative scale.
A layout where several items lead into one.
A tiny coloured square labelling a card type.
